# Blockly 12.3.1

Copied from the `blockly@12.3.1` npm package (https://github.com/google/blockly), Apache License 2.0
(https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0). Kept here so the editor doesn't load anything from a
third-party CDN, which keeps visitors' details away from other companies.

To upgrade: download the new npm package, replace these files (the three `*_compressed.js` files,
`msg/en.js`, `msg/pl.js` and `media/`), and change `BLOCKLY_VERSION` in app.py.
